factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position: Total equity was EUR 182,039 thousand as at 31 March 2026 and EUR 166,276 thousand as at 31 December 2025. The increase aligns with net profit of EUR 15,763 thousand reported in Q1 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Total borrowings decreased to EUR 104,174 thousand as at 31 March 2026 from EUR 123,666 thousand at the end of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 18: Total borrowings were EUR 104,174 thousand as at 31 March 2026 and EUR 123,666 thousand as at 31 December 2025.

factual_claims.claim: During the period, a tripartite loan transfer agreement with the Nordic Investment Bank came into effect on 25 February 2026, transferring the remaining loan to parent company EPSO-G and releasing the company from prior financial covenants, which also eliminated cross-default enforcement risks and allowed the reclassification of European Investment Bank borrowings back to non-current liabilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 18: 'On 25 February 2026, the confirmation was received from the Nordic Investment Bank regarding the entry into force of the tripartite loan transfer agreement concluded on 22 December 2025, effective from 25 February 2026. Upon the entry into force of this agreement, the remaining loan amount - EUR 9,783 thousand - was assumed by EPSO-G, and the Company is no longer subject to financial covenants... Accordingly, the Company reclassified the European Investment Bank loan from a current financial liability to a non-current financial liability.'

factual_claims.claim: Net debt stood at EUR 106,610 thousand at the end of March 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 20: Net debt as at 31 March 2026 was EUR (106,610) thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Significant ongoing matters include legal disputes, notably involving claims with construction contractor Alvora UAB over warranty obligations for the GIPL pipeline project, for which the company holds a provision of EUR 5,815 thousand for the potential repayment of guarantee funds received.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 21: A provision of EUR 5,815 thousand is recognized for the potential repayment of guarantee funds received from Alvora UAB related to the GIPL pipeline project. Note 34 details the ongoing legal dispute.

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent to the reporting period, on 17 April 2026, the general meeting of shareholders approved the distribution of 2025 profits, allocating EUR 9,989 thousand, or EUR 0.0560 per share, for dividend payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 36: 'On 17 April 2026 the General Meeting of Shareholders adopted the decisions to approve the Company’s financial statements for 2025 year and the distribution of profits.
